messages:
mira: Morning team — quick slate for today. Lean updates only: what you shipped yesterday, any blockers, and what you'll focus on. I’ll do a fast triage and reassign priorities if needed.

alex: Shipped the /routing cache change to staging last night. Verified end-to-end on small load. Saw slightly higher 95th p50 (about +8ms) but overall looks stable. No blockers. Today: run perf sweep across long-tail sequences and prep canary.

sam: Pushed spec updates for the new rollout policy to the doc (link: https://redwood/s/specs/rollout-policies). Waiting on product review for the fallback logic. Blocker: need decision on whether fallback model is quantized or fp16 for latency tradeoffs.

mira: @sam thanks — product call: prefer quantized fallback for cost but keep fp16 as option if quality regresses. Can you put both in the canary matrix?

sam: Yep — will add both. Will also include the prompt set for evals. ETA end of day.

tanya: Code review ping for alex: PR #472 has the cache TTL tweak + test updates. Left one question about the test harness timeout. Can we extend to 2s?

alex: @tanya thanks — extended to 2s and pushed. Also added a short note in the PR description about why TTL=600s is safe.

leo: Blocker for me: infra quota for dedicated GPUs is at 90% in eu-west-1 which may impact the canary tomorrow. Filed a request with infra but need someone to approve emergency burst until we autoscale.

mira: @leo I can approve a short burst. @devops-bot can you open a ticket for a temporary quota bump and tag infra on-call?

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2145 for temporary GPU quota bump (requested by mira). Notifying infra-oncall. ETA: 3–4hrs. :white_check_mark:

leo: Awesome, thanks. I’ll hold off the canary until INFRA-2145 is confirmed.

tanya: Quick note — QA found an edge case where embed cache misses happen when the request has empty metadata header. Added a failing test in PR #479. Alex, do you want me to revert the metadata check or add a guard?

alex: Prefer guard + test. I'll take PR #479 after I finish the perf sweep. Might be noon-ish.

mira: Prioritization call: if INFRA-2145 isn't green by 11:30 PT, we shift canary to next window and proceed with the spec review + evals in parallel. If quota is green, we run a limited canary only for 30m with both fallback variants.

sam: Sounds good. I’ll finalize the eval harness and upload baseline metrics to the shared folder.

tanya: I'll re-run QA against the guard branch and drop notes in the PR.

alex: Perf sweep started — dropping updates in the perf thread. Will also tag @mira when ready for canary if infra is green.

mira: Thanks all. If anything critical blocks, ping me directly. Otherwise I’ll post a canary plan and snapshot of priorities by 10:45. :rocket:
